create_vibevoice_asr_processor: create a VibeVoiceASRProcessor that wraps a feature extractor and tokenizer for audio-text ASR
run_vibevoice_asr_processing: run the VibeVoice ASR processor on text and audio inputs to produce tokenized features and labels
build_transcription_request: build an ASR transcription request from audio samples and optional prompts using apply_transcription_request
decode_asr_output: decode VibeVoice ASR model output as raw, parsed speaker dicts, or transcription-only strings
extract_speaker_dict: extract speaker dictionaries with timestamps from raw decoded ASR output text
